label: 走路循环
note: 散步速度，两步一个循环，手空着
subject: a chibi armored warrior with a red horsehair plume and a long red cape, one silver broadsword
invariants: identical proportions, colors and costume details in every frame
the camera is locked off for the whole clip
the weight stays over the feet and a planted foot never slides
every beat lands at its stated second, in every direction
the sword stays in the right hand at the same angle throughout

beats.motion: the NEAR foot swings forward in a clear arc, knee lifting high enough to push the hem up, and plants ahead of the far foot; the far foot pushes back so the stride is wide.
both feet gather under the hips and the body rises to the passing pose.
the FAR foot swings forward and plants ahead while the near foot drives back — the legs visibly swap places.
gather and rise, then land back on the opening stance.

close: The final pose matches the opening pose so the last frame can be followed directly by the first.

front.anchor: the red chest emblem, both shoulder guards and the face under the plume

back.anchor: the long red cape hanging over the whole back and the plume from behind
